reader_summary.overview: Dmitry Balyasny is the founder, Managing Partner, and Chief Investment Officer of Balyasny Asset Management. The firm launched in the early 2000s and today has 2,000 employees across 15 global offices. Our conversation is a master class in all aspects of the multi-manager model.

key_points.text: Dmitry Balyasny is the founder, Managing Partner, and Chief Investment Officer of Balyasny Asset Management.
We cover everything - learning to trade, building new strategies, attracting talent, managing an individual pod, portfolio and risk management, the competitive landscape.
Dmitry is a gifted money manager and business builder, and both sides come out in spades.
